function: Excluded (system): DDQN with ADMM-Net selects ISAC time-sharing, radar mode and rate (area 5), but links are single-antenna, no array or RIS: scalar SINR (p. 4).
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match the PDF. Checks 1-5 pass: research article; the learned components are ADMM-Net, p. 8: "we leverage the deep unfolding technique to transform ADMM into a neural network, termed ADMM-Net", which completes missing environmental states, and a DDQN (p. 8) that chooses at each step between radar sensing and V2I communication, the FMCW radar mode (p. 3: "each mode corresponding to a particular sweep bandwidth and frequency sweep slope"), the message type, and the rate level (p. 6, eq. 12). Radar waveform and rate are physical-layer decisions learned jointly with message scheduling, and the time and waveform allocation between sensing and communication is an ISAC (area 5) problem. Check 6 applies: the system has no antenna array, beamformer, or RIS; the V2I link is a scalar SINR, p. 4: "the received signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) η at the RSUs can be expressed as" eq. (5), abstracted on p. 5: "it is abstracted as the channel quality level, and satisfies c ∈ {1, 2, . . ., 10}"; radar and communication "share the same antenna" (p. 1); Table I (p. 5) and Fig. 1 (p. 3) show no antennas or RIS. Area 5 with single-antenna links and no RIS, so exclude for system; the simulation results (pp. 10-12) would otherwise satisfy check 7. If the reviewer reads the radar/communication function selection as scheduling above the PHY, the code would be above_phy instead; the work is excluded either way.
